name: the model cannot talk its way past an ask-list rule either
why: §34.9's last pitfall, tested explicitly: `git push --force` is on the ask list, the model is 0.99 sure it should be allowed, and the answer is still ask. Row 1 returns before `answers` is read at all.

rules.reason: Mewndo: `git push --force` can destroy work git cannot bring back. Waiting for the user.
